children: - Subsea7 S.A. (Oslo Børs: SUBC, ADR: SUBCY) today announced the award of a sizeable1 extension of an existing frame agreement by Equinor for
The original agreement was signed in 2018 and had previously been extended to the end of 2027.

will provide subsea inspection, maintenance and repair (IMR) for Equinor’s oil and gas wells across the Norwegian Continental Shelf. Project management and engineering will continue from Subsea7’s Stavanger office.
Erik Femsteinevik, Vice President Norway at Subsea7, said:

“We welcome Equinor’s decision to extend the agreement. With Seven Viking continuing into 2028, we look forward to building on our experience together and supporting safe, efficient subsea operations on the Norwegian Continental Shelf.”
Subsea7 defines sizeable as being between USD 50 million and USD 150 million.

Subsea7 is a global leader in the delivery of offshore projects and services for the evolving energy industry, creating sustainable value by being the industry’s partner and employer of choice in delivering the efficient offshore solutions the world needs.
Subsea7 is listed on the Oslo Børs (SUBC), ISIN LU0075646355, LEI 222100AIF0CBCY80AH62.
